body:
Termal::Opus2 engram-data sync procedure fix (2026-11-19). In my one-shot sync command the disclosure grep printed a match, and the chain still went on to commit and push. The construction was `grep ... || echo "scan clean"` followed by `git add ... && git commit ... && push`, and a match does not stop that chain.

This time the match was a false positive: the word "secrets" in task text ("no message bodies, receipts or secrets"), checked after the fact.

From now on, run the scan alone first. Only when it prints nothing does a separate command commit and push. Any match is inspected before any commit.
